recognize_zh: 成群的中大型芽細胞核質比高、染色質細緻，數顆細胞核中可見淡染的凹陷區（杯狀核凹陷，cup-like nuclear invagination），加上NPM1 突變的病史，符合 NPM1 突變急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Medium-to-large blasts, about 2 RBC diameters, occurring in cohesive-appearing clusters on the smear
High N:C ratio with a narrow rim of pale blue, agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods seen
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this resolution
Several nuclei show a pale, clear area at the nuclear margin, consistent with cup-like (fish-mouth) nuclear invaginations
Some nuclei indented or folded; cytoplasm often concentrated at one pole
Background of red cells with no maturing granulocytes in the field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous blasts, including clusters, in a background of unremarkable red cells with no maturing myeloid cells in these fields. The blasts are medium to large with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a scant rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm; Auer rods are not identified. Several blasts show a pale, sharply demarcated clear zone indenting the nucleus, consistent with cup-like nuclear invaginations, and others have folded nuclear contours. In conjunction with the detected NPM1 exon 12 frameshift mutation, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with mutated NPM1.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed/folded nuclei with fine granules or Auer rod bundles and is CD34/HLA-DR negative with PML::RARA, whereas cuplike blasts here are agranular.

ddx.dx: AML with FLT3-ITD or myelomonocytic AML without NPM1
ddx.vs: Cup-like invaginations are not specific; NPM1 molecular testing or aberrant cytoplasmic NPM1 immunohistochemistry is the discriminator.
Lymphoblasts can look similar and lack granules, so MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry (myeloid vs lymphoid lineage markers) are required.
Monoblasts have more abundant, often vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm and delicately folded nuclei with nonspecific esterase positivity.

captions: Cluster of three blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and scant agranular blue cytoplasm.
Cluster of blasts, several with pale cup-like nuclear invaginations.
